content.comment_body: Hello, I’m having an issue with [product_name] [version_no]. 1. The simulation bar displays the current time, which matches the operating system time. By clicking on it, I can set the date and time, and apply changes instantly. 2. Next to it is a clock icon. When I hover over it, a message appears, showing 'date and time for simulation'. Adjusting these values also updates the current time, depending on whether the 'Apply values immediately' checkbox is checked. According to the Help menu for [product_name], it describes: Current time - shows the current time. Clock icon - allows changes to date and time. Does anyone have advice?

Both options serve the same purpose: They change the date and time for simulation. The only difference is in their icons (digital vs analog clocks). The digital icon also displays a tooltip with the date and time.

analysis.insight_summary: Users are unclear about the distinct roles of the current time display and the simulation adjustment icon within the simulation toolbar of [product_name] [version_no]. Because both controls essentially offer the same function but are represented differently, this causes confusion and impacts the clarity and usability of the simulation feature.
analysis.user_expectations: Users want better clarity and separation between the current time display and the simulation adjustment icon. They expect intuitive, easy-to-understand controls for managing simulation time settings.
